blocks.value: Every program you have written so far runs top to bottom, every line, every time. That is a **sequential structure**, and it can only ever do one thing.

Real programs decide. Passed or failed. Discount or full price. Valid input or try again. This lesson is where your programs stop being a fixed recipe and start responding to what is actually in front of them.
What you will be able to do
By the end of this lesson you will be able to:

items: Distinguish sequential, selection, and repetition structures
Write one-way and two-way selections with `if` and `if...else`
Build multiple selections with nested `if` and `else if`
Test a single variable against many values with `switch`
